snapshot.title: Guanajuato - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description:
This beautiful red shade was inspired by the Mexican city of Guanajuato, also called the land of legends, known for its rich history, fascinating legends, and colorful buildings. The most famous alley is the Callejón del Beso or Alley of the Kiss. Located on the slopes of a hill in a neighborhood that dates back to the 18th century, the legend says that couples who kiss on the third step (painted in red) are guaranteed seven years of happiness together.

This color is best described as a dark deep red.
snapshot.pdp_how_to_use_raw: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.
